blocks.text: This guide helps business owners, project teams, platform operators, providers, and auditors agree who must protect what. A secure framework cannot compensate for missing production secrets, open networks, unprotected backups, or absent operational ownership.
Think of Nodics as a secure building design.

items: Nodics supplies doors, locks, room boundaries, access rules, alarms, and
The project decides who receives access and how the building is customized.
Infrastructure operates the site, network, keys, backups, and monitoring.
The business decides which information is sensitive and which rules apply.
